source_and_recovery.reason: Pinned-base tree metadata lookup rejected by offline mode after eval fit saved. Reuse that fit and require cached-only snapshot resolution; no recipe or gates changed.
source_and_recovery.artifact_capture_note: Full checkpoint digests captured after resume started, before any checkpoint modification; all are checked again after completion. Resume initially checked the model digest and existence of modules/config files.

limitations: This trial predates the WordNet neighbour ordering correction; process hash salts changed selected positive pairs, so it is not an exactly replayable fixed-pair experiment.
Original and resumed evaluation-stage pair counts differ; retained checkpoint bytes were unchanged, but the selected pair lists were not captured.
Current-entry split is shared with shipped1.2 evaluation, but some entries may have been seen by1.2; not a common unseen holdout.

Raw frozen gap metrics are historical fixed-query diagnostics; sozzled/starved/kitchen/umbrella now have dictionary coverage. They are not current unseen generalisation or real current false-fill rates.
Dictionary growth and cleaner changes both differ from prior trials; no causal improvement claim.
Candidate lookups use a Model2Vec Embedder adapter; no exported package reader or shipping claim.
